description: Emails a short note to an active client from the platform address, with replies going to the signed-in coach's email. Use when the user wants to check in with, nudge or update a client. Not for content notifications (assign_content_to_client sends those). Returns a confirmation. Limit: 1 message per hour and 3 per day per client; the email can't be unsent.

body.description: Email body, plain text, 1 to 400 characters, e.g. "Great week, Ana. Two more sessions to hit your target."

client_id.description: ID of the client (their user ID). Get it from list_clients (the "id" of each client), e.g. "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1".

subject.description: Email subject, plain text, 1 to 80 characters, e.g. "Quick check-in".

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: message_client
title: Email a client
